name: Dandong Haotong Commercial Trade Co. Ltd.

attribution.legal_posture: UN Panel reporting includes Member State information; adjudication and independently verified corporate-control findings require separate sources.

caveats: China replied that the Panel had offered no concrete clues or evidence and that fragmented information prevented a targeted investigation; China also said it was still coordinating relevant authorities to investigate.
Japan's Korea Computer Center aliases and Dandong Haotong remain separate; Japan's designation concerns its named target.
The Chinese registry description establishes Dandong Haotong's registration and stated business lines; beneficial ownership and actual IT-worker activity require separate evidence.
The legacy record ID retains a historical -kcc suffix for reference stability; the record subject is Dandong Haotong only.
The reported KCC use of the Dandong Haotong front-company name remains a source-qualified UN Panel and Member State claim; alias, beneficial-ownership, and judicial-finding status remain qualified.

statements: The Panel reported that Korea Computer Center, described by another Member State as belonging to the Munitions Industry Department 313 General Bureau, used Dandong Haotong Commercial Trade Co. Ltd. as a front-company name in Dandong, China.
Chinese registry information showed Dandong Haotong was registered in 2013 with broad wholesale, retail, import and export business lines that did not disclose the reported IT-worker role.

sources.support: Verifies the exact Dandong Haotong name, KCC use as a front name, registration description and China response
